disorder-name.detail: Alzheimer's disease; patients with established dementia (CDR ≥ 1) from the OASIS3 dataset, evaluated against normative models built from healthy controls (CDR = 0)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "209 scans correspond to patients with established AD having CDR ≥ 1"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Open Access Series of Imaging Studies-3 (OASIS3); publicly available dataset at www.oasis-brains.org/
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The OASIS3 dataset (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies, LaMontagne et al., 2019) is publicly available at www.oasis-brains.org/"

age.detail: Age at scan for CDR ≥ 1 group (112 participants, 180 scans in Table 1). Table 1 excludes 60 scans from 15 patients with CDR changing between different levels of CDR ≥ 0.5. The full AD evaluation used 209 scans with CDR ≥ 1.

sex.detail: Participant-level counts for CDR ≥ 1 group (N=112). Table reports female N=56 (50.0%); male N estimated by subtraction (112 - 56 = 56). Table 1 excludes 15 patients with CDR changing between levels.
